mintAuthority.summary: WARS has six reviewed independent native issuer deployments on Ethereum, Base, World Chain, BSC, Polygon, and Gnosis. The shared issuer EOA 0x466c02e2 has direct DEFAULT_ADMIN, MINTER_ROLE, UPGRADER_ROLE, and PAUSER_ROLE on each; the 4-of-7 WARS Safe 0x2b839174 can authorize native minters; and the Ethereum LimitedMinter 0xd168cfbb is a separate fixed-destination native mint facility. The BridgeDeposit/LimitedMinterBridge transfer rail is assessed only in Bridge Risk. Celo is a live but unlisted native deployment pending catalog-owner adjudication and is not included in this Mint Authority scope.

controls.label: Ripio shared WARS admin and MINTER_ROLE holder (EOA)
controls.evidence: At the 2026-08-16 fixed reads, hasRole(MINTER_ROLE), hasRole(UPGRADER_ROLE), and hasRole(PAUSER_ROLE) returned true for 0x466c02e2 on Ethereum block 25771188, Base block 50068421, World Chain block 33795277, BSC block 116367712, Polygon block 92147450, and Gnosis block 47763061; its Ethereum code is empty. The WARS token exposes no supply cap, so this direct issuer MINTER_ROLE path remains unbounded and is independent of the separate BridgeDeposit/LimitedMinterBridge transfer rail.

controls.label: Ripio WARS Safe multisig (DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE)
controls.evidence: The current WARS Safe is 4-of-7 with the reviewed owners and remains the shared DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE authority able to authorize native minters and upgrades on the six authored deployments. The token exposes no supply cap, so mint authorized by this Safe is unbounded. Safe module and guard state was not fully re-enumerated after the current owner read and remains explicitly unknown here. This does not change the native posture.

controls.label: Ripio WARS Ethereum minter-router contract
controls.evidence: The verified Ethereum LimitedMinter 0xd168cfbb remains a separate issuer-operated fixed-destination minter with a daily cap; its source does not implement cross-chain recipient fulfillment. It is retained as a native controlled mint facility, while the arbitrary-recipient LimitedMinterBridge is assessed only in Bridge Risk.

sources.label: Independent accountant wARS certification at 31 March 2026

review.evidence: On 2026-08-16, current fixed reads verified the shared issuer EOA's direct MINTER_ROLE, UPGRADER_ROLE, and PAUSER_ROLE on the six authored native WARS deployments: Ethereum block 25771188, Base 50068421, World Chain 33795277, BSC 116367712, Polygon 92147450, and Gnosis 47763061. The EOA is empty-code on Ethereum; the WARS Safe remains 4-of-7 and can authorize native minters and upgrades. The Ethereum LimitedMinter is a fixed-destination native facility. The separate BridgeDeposit plus LimitedMinterBridge arbitrary-recipient burn/mint rail, its operators, route configuration, fees, pause, and daily limit are deliberately excluded from Mint Authority and preserved in bridgeRouteRisk. The six native paths remain uncapped, periodically reconciled, and subject only to attestation-style reserve supervision. Celo is a live official-network deployment but remains explicitly unlisted pending catalog-owner adjudication.
